data.titulo: Oshitopolwa 7—Okuza Eyumuko lyaJesus sigo Uukwatwa waPaulus
data.contenido:
Jesus okwa yumuka mesiku etitatu konima yeso lye. Mesiku ndyoka ye okwi ihololele aalanduli ye poompito dha yoolokathana dhi li ntano. Jesus okwa tsikile noku yi ihololela iikando niikando yomasiku 40. Konima yaashono, manga yamwe yomaalongwa ye taa tala, Jesus okwa londo a yi megulu. Sho omasiku 10 ga piti po, Kalunga okwa tilile ombepo ondjapuki maalanduli yaJesus mboka ya tegelela muJerusalem.

Konima aatondi yaKalunga oye edhilile aayapostoli mondholongo, ihe omuyengeli okwe ya mangulula mo. Omulongwa Stefanus okwa dhipagwa nomamanya kaapataneki. Ihe tse otatu ilongo nkene Jesus a hogolola gumwe gwomaapataneki mboka a kale omukalele gwe i ikalekelwa, nokwa ningi omuyapostoli Paulus. Opo nduno oomvula ndatu netata konima yeso lyaJesus, Kalunga okwa tumu omuyapostoli Petrus e ku uvithile Kornelius ngoka kee shi Omujuda nuukwanegumbo we.

Konima yoomvula 13 lwaampono Paulus okwa tameke nolweendo lwe lwetumo lwotango. Pethimbo lyolweendo lwe olutiyali Timoteus okwa yi pamwe naPaulus. Tse otatu ilongo nkene Paulus naaendi ooyakwawo ya li ye na iimoniwa oyindji iituntulimwenyo miilonga yaKalunga. Lwahugunina Paulus ote edhililwa mondholongo muRoma. Konima yoomvula mbali ye okwa mangululwa mo, ihe konima ye okwa tulwa ishewe mondholongo nokwa dhipagwa. Iiningwanima yOSHITOPOLWA 7 oya ningwa konyala meni lyoomvula 32.

OWA tseya kutya omukiintu naalumentu yaali oyo oolye? Omukiintu oMaria Magdalena, kuume kaJesus. Naalumentu yoonguwo oontokele oyo aayengeli. Okala haka okashona moka Maria to ontamene, omo mehala moka olutu lwaJesus lwa tulwa konima yeso lye. Ohaki ithanwa ombila. Ihe ngashingeyi olutu kalu mo! Olye e lu kutha mo? Natu tale.

Konima yeso lyaJesus, aasaaseri otaa ti kuPilatus: ‘Sho Jesus a li natango e na omwenyo okwa tile kutya ye ota ka yumuka konima yomasiku gatatu. Ano gandja elombwelo opo ombila yi langelwe. Opo nduno aalongwa ye itaa vulu ya yake mo omudhimba gwe noya tye kutya ye okwa yumuka kuusi!’ Pilatus ota lombwele aasaaseri ya tume aakwiita ya ka langele ombila.

Ihe ongula onene yesiku etitatu konima yeso lyaJesus omuyengeli gwaJehova ota holoka ombadhilila. Ye ota kandula po emanya pombila. Aakwiita oya pwa oonkondo kuumbanda. Lwahugunina sho yo yo ontamene mombila, omudhimba kagu mo! Yamwe yomaakwiita otaa yi koshilando notaa hokololele aasaaseri. Owa tseya mbela kutya aasaaseri aawinayi otaa ningi po shike? Yo otaa futu aakwiita opo ya fundje. ‘Ne omu na okutya kutya aalongwa ye oye ya uusiku noya yaka mo omudhimba omanga tse twa kotha,’ aasaaseri taa lombwele aakwiita.

Opo tuu mpoka ookuume kaJesus yamwe aakiintu otaa talele po ombila. Alikana oya kumwa ngiini oku yi mona yi li owala! Ombadhilila aayengeli yaali otaa holoka ya zala oonguwo tadhi adhima! ‘Omolwashike tamu kongo Jesus muka?’ yo taa pula. ‘Ye okwa yumuka. Indeni mbala mu ka hokololele aalongwa ye.’ Alikana aakiintu otaa matuka neendelelo ngiini! Ihe mondjila omulumentu ote ya kankameke. Owa tseya tuu kutya oye lye? Oye Jesus! ‘Indeni mu ka hokololele aalongwa yandje,’ ye ta ti.

Sho aakiintu ya hokololele aalongwa kutya Jesus oku na omwenyo nonokutya yo oye mu mona, aalongwa otaa mono oshidhigu oku shi itaala. Petrus naJohannes otaa matukile kombila ya ka tale yo yene, ihe ombila oyi li owala! Sho Petrus naJohannes taa shuna, Maria Magdalena ota kala ko. Opo tuu mpono ye oto ontamene mo nota mono aayengeli yaali.

Owa tseya mbela shoka sha ningilwa olutu lwaJesus? Kalunga okwe lu kanithitha mo. Kalunga ina yumudha Jesus nolutu lwopanyama ndoka a si nalwo. Ye okwa pe Jesus olutu olupe lwopambepo, ngaashi aayengeli megulu ye lu na. Ihe okuulikila aalongwa ye kutya ye oku na omwenyo, Jesus ota vulu okukutha olutu ndoka aantu taa vulu okumona, ngaashi tatu ki ilonga. Mateus 27:62-66; 28:1-15; Lukas 24:1-12; Johannes 20:1-12.

SHO Petrus naJohannes ya thigi po ombila moka mwa li olutu lwaJesus, Maria ota kala po oye awike. Ye ota tameke ta lili. Opo nduno ota petama e to ontamene mombila, ngaashi twa mono mefano lya tetekele. Moka ye ota mono aayengeli yaali! Yo otaye mu pula: ‘Omolwashike to lili?’

Maria ota yamukula: ‘Yo oya kutha mo Omuwa gwandje, nokandi shi wo mpoka yo ye mu tula.’ Opo nduno Maria ota punguluka nota mono omulumentu. Ye ote mu pula: ‘Oto kongo lye?’

Maria ota dhiladhila kutya omulumentu oye omukeeleli gweyana, nonokutya sikulimwe oye a kutha mo olutu lwaJesus. Ano ye ota ti: ‘Ngele ongoye we mu kutha mo, lombwela ndje mpoka we mu tula.’ Ihe omulumentu muushili wo wene oye Jesus. Ye okwa kutha olutu ndoka Maria itaa dhimbulula. Ihe sho ye e mu tumbula kedhina, Maria ota tseya kutya oye Jesus. Ye ota matuka nota hokololele aalongwa: ‘Ngame onda mona Omuwa!’

Konima yesiku tuu ndyoka, manga aalongwa yaali taa yi komukunda Emaus, omulumentu ota tameke okweenda pamwe nayo. Aalongwa oya yemata noonkondo molwashoka Jesus a dhipagwa. Ihe manga taye ende, omulumentu ota yelitha iinima oyindji yomOmbimbeli, notashi ya uvitha nawa. Lwahugunina, sho taa li uulalelo, aalongwa otaa dhimbulukwa kutya omulumentu nguka oJesus. Opo nduno Jesus ota nena po, naalongwa mbano yaali otaa shuna mbala kuJerusalem oku ka hokololela aayapostoli.

Opo tuu mpoka Jesus oti ihololele wo Petrus. Yalwe oya nyanyukwa sho taye shi uvu. Opo nduno aalongwa mbaka yaali otaa yi kuJerusalem notaa mono aayapostoli. Yo otaye ya hokololele nkene Jesus e yi ihololele mondjila. Mbela ngoye owa tseya ngaa kutya oshinima oshikumithi shini po sha ningwa po manga yo yi ipyakidhila natango oku shi ya hokololela?

Tala kefano. Jesus ota holoka lelalela mpoka mondjugo, nokuli nando omweelo ogwa patwa. Alikana aalongwa oya nyanyukwa ngiini! Esiku etuntulimwenyo ngiini! Oto vulu mbela okuyalula kutya iikando ingapi nale Jesus i ihololele aalongwa ye? Oto mono wo itano?

Omuyapostoli Tomas ka li pamwe nayo sho Jesus ta holoka. Ano aalongwa otaa ti kuye: ‘Tse otwa mona Omuwa!’ Ihe Tomas ota ti ye okwa hala a mone Jesus ye mwene manga ye inee shi itaala. Konima yomasiku gahetatu aalongwa oye li ishewe mondjugo ya patwa, noshikando shino Tomas opo e li. Ombadhilila Jesus ota holoka lelalela mpoka mondjugo. Ngashingeyi Tomas okwi itaala. Johannes 20:11-29; Lukas 24:13-43.

POMASIKU ga landula ko Jesus oti ihololele aalongwa ye iikando oyindji. Oshikando shimwe konyala 500 yomaalongwa ye otaye mu mono. Owa tseya mbela kutya okombinga yashike Jesus ta popi sho te yi ihololele? Uukwaniilwa waKalunga. Jehova okwa tumu Jesus kombanda yevi okuuvitha Uukwaniilwa. Note shi ningi nokuli sho ye a yumuka.

Oto dhimbulukwa mbela kutya Uukwaniilwa waKalunga oshike? Eeno, Uukwaniilwa owo epangelo lyoshili lyaKalunga li li megulu, na Jesus Oye ngoka a hogololwa kuKalunga a kale omukwaniilwa. Ngaashi tse twi ilonga, Jesus okwa holola kutya ye ota ka kala omukwaniilwa omukumithi guni po mokupalutha aasindjala, mokwaaludha aavu nokuyumudha aasi nokuli!

Ano kombanda yevi otaku ka kala ngiini uuna Jesus ta pangele megulu uule woomvula eyuvi limwe oye omukwaniilwa? Eeno, evi alihe otali ka longwa oparadisa ombwanawa. Itapu ka kala we iita, iilonga yomuyonena, omikithi nenge eso nokuli. Tse otu shi shi kutya osho oshili, oshoka Kalunga okwa shiti evi li kale oparadisa ndjoka aantu taa vulu okunyanyukilwa. Osho molwashoka petameko ye a ningi oshikunino shaEden. Jesus nota ka tonatela opo ehalo lyaKalunga lwahugunina li gwanithwe.

Ngashingeyi ethimbo olya thikana kuJesus a shune megulu. Jesus okwi ihololele aalongwa ye uule womasiku 40. Ano yo oye na uushili kutya ye oku na ishewe omwenyo. Ihe manga ye inaa thiga po aalongwa ye, ye ota ti kuyo: ‘Kaleni muJerusalem sigo tamu ka pewa ombepo ondjapuki.’ Ombepo ondjapuki oyo oonkondo dhaKalunga dhokulongitha, ngaashi ombepo hayi pepe, ndjoka tayi ka kwathela aalanduli ye okulonga ehalo lyaKalunga. Lwahugunina Jesus ota ti: ‘Ne omu na okuuvitha kombinga yandje sigo omiitopolwa yokooha dhevi.’

Konima sho Jesus e shi ti, opwa ningwa oshinima oshikumithi. Ye ota tameke ta yeluthwa po a ye megulu, ngaashi to vulu oku shi mona mpaka. Opo nduno ye ota kanene konima yoshikogo naalongwa kaye wete we Jesus. Jesus ota yi megulu nota tameke okupangela kombanda yaalongwa ye yokevi okuza moka. 1 Aakorinto 15:3-8; Ehololo 21:3, 4; Iilonga 1:1-11.

AANTU mbaka oyo aalanduli yaJesus. Yo oya vulika kuye noya kala muJerusalem. Manga yo ya tegelela ayehe pamwe, ekudhilo olyu udha egumbo alihe. Otali inyenge lya fa okambiya hoka taka pepe. Nopo nduno elaka lyomulilo otali holoka kombanda yomutse gwomulongwa kehe. Ngoye oto vulu mbela okumona omulilo kombanda yomutse gwakehe gumwe? Ayihe mbino otayi ti shike?

Osho oshikumithalonga! Jesus oku li megulu puHe, nota tilile aalanduli ye ombepo ondjapuki yaKalunga. Owa tseya mbela kutya ombepo ndjika otayi ya longitha shike? Yo ayehe otaa tameke okupopya momalaka gi ili nogi ili.

Aantu oyendji muJerusalem otayu uvu ewi ndyoka tali inyenge lya fa okambiya, notaye ya ya tale shoka tashi ningwa po. Yamwe yomaantu mboka oya zi miigwana yilwe noye ya koshituthi shAaisrael shaPentekoste. Alikana onkumwe oyi thike peni aayenda mbano taa mono! Yo otayu uvu nkene aalongwa taa popi momalaka gawo yene kombinga yiinima iikumithi mbyoka Kalunga a ningi.

‘Aantu mbaka ayehe oyokuGalilea,’ aayenda taa ti. ‘Ongiini ano tashi vulika yo ya popye momalaka gi ili nogi ili gokiilongo hoka tse twa zi?’

Ngashingeyi Petrus ota thikama e ya yelithile. Ye ota fala ewi lye pombanda nota hokololele aantu nkene Jesus a dhipagwa nonokutya Jehova okwe mu yumudha. ‘Ngashingeyi Jesus oku li megulu kolulyo lwaKalunga,’ Petrus ta ti. ‘Noye a tilile ombepo ondjapuki yu uvanekwa. Osho molwashoka ne tamu mono notamu uvu iikumithalonga mbika.’

Ano sho Petrus ta popi iinima mbino, oyendji yomaantu oyu uvite nayi kombinga yaashono sha ningilwa Jesus. ‘Otu na okuninga ngiini?’ yo taa pula. Petrus ota ti kuyo: ‘Ne omu na okulundulula onkalamwenyo yeni nomu ninginithwe.’ Ano esiku olyo tuu ndyoka aantu konyala 3 000 oyi ininginitha noya ningi aalanduli yaJesus. Iilonga 2:1-47.

TALA komuyengeli ngoka te egulula omweelo gwondholongo. Aalumentu mboka ye ta mangulula mo, oyo aayapostoli yaJesus. Natu tale kutya omolwashike yo ya tulwa mondholongo.

Osho owala okathimbo okafupi okuza sho ombepo ondjapuki ya tililwa maalongwa yaJesus. Nosho shika tashi ningwa po: Omutenya gumwe Petrus naJohannes otaa yi kotempeli muJerusalem. Hoka, popepi nomweelo, opu na omulumentu ngoka a kala oshitiningili uule wonkalamwenyo ye ayihe. Aantu ohaye mu fala ongula kehe hoka opo a vule okuhehela iimaliwa kwaamboka taye ya kotempeli. Sho ye a mono Petrus naJohannes, ye ota hehela wo kuyo. Aayapostoli otaa ka ninga po nee ngiini?

Yo otaa thikama ya mwena notaa tala komulumentu. ‘Ngame kandi na iimaliwa,’ Petrus ta ti, ‘ihe otandi ku pe shoka ndi na. Medhina lyaJesus, thikama ngoye u ende!’ Petrus ota kwata nduno oshikaha shomulumentu shokolulyo, nomulumentu ota nuka po mbala nota tameke te ende. Sho aantu taye shi mono, yo oya kumwa noya nyanyukwa noonkondo kombinga yoshikumithalonga shika.

‘Osho koonkondo dhaKalunga, ngoka a yumudha Jesus, tse twa longo oshikumithalonga shika,’ Petrus ta ti. Manga ye naJohannes natango taa popi, aawiliki yomalongelokalunga otaye ya po. Yo oya geya molwashoka Petrus naJohannes taa hokololele oshigwana kutya Jesus okwa yumuka. Ano otaye ya kwata notaye ya umbile mondholongo.

Esiku lya landula aawiliki yomalongelokalunga oye na oshigongi oshinene. Petrus naJohannes nomulumentu ngoka yo ya aludha, otaye etwa mo. ‘Okoonkondo dhalye ne mwa longo oshikumithalonga shika?’ aawiliki yomalongelokalunga taa pula.

Petrus ote ya lombwele kutya okoonkondo dhaKalunga, ngoka a yumudha Jesus. Aasaaseri kaye shi wo shoka ye na okuninga, oshoka yo itaa vulu okwiidhimbika kutya oshikumithalonga shika inashi longwa shili. Ano yo otaa londodha aayapostoli yaa popye we kombinga yaJesus, notaye ya etha ya ye.

Aayapostoli otaa tsikile nokuuvitha kombinga yaJesus nokwaaludha aavu. Onkundana kombinga yiikumithalonga mbika otayi taandele. Ano nokuli oongundu dhaantu yomoondoolopa dhomomudhingoloko gwaJerusalem otadhi eta aavu kaayapostoli ya aludhwe. Otashi tsitha ondumbo aawiliki yomalongelokalunga, ano yo otaa kwata aayapostoli notaye ya umbile mondholongo. Ihe yo itaa kala mo ethimbo ele.

Uusiku omuyengeli gwaKalunga ote egulula omweelo gwondholongo, ngaashi to vulu okumona mpaka. Omuyengeli ota ti: ‘Indeni kotempeli ne mu tsikile nokupopya naantu.’ Sho ongula ya landula aawiliki yomalongelokalunga ya tumu aalumentu kondholongo ya ka tale aayapostoli, yo kaye mo. Konima aalumentu otaye ya mono yi ipyakidhila nokulonga aantu motempeli notaye ye eta koshinyanga shaSanhedrin.

‘Tse otwe mu lombwele sha yela mwaa longe we kombinga yaJesus,’ aawiliki yomalongelokalunga taa ti. ‘Ihe ne omu udhitha Jerusalem nelongo lyeni.’ Opo nduno aayapostoli otaa yamukula: ‘Tse otu na okuvulika kuKalunga shi vulithe kaantu.’ Ano yo otaa tsikile nokuuvitha “onkundana ombwanawa.” Shika oshiholelwa oshiwanawa kutse, hasho mbela? Iilonga ontopolwa 3 sigo 5.

OYE Stefanus ngoka ta tsu oongolo mpaka. Ye omulongwa omudhiginini gwaJesus. Ihe tala shoka tashi mu ningilwa ngashingeyi! Aalumentu mbaka otaye mu dhaadhiga nomamanya omanene. Omolwashike yo ye tonde Stefanus unene ngawo opo ye mu ningile oshinima shino oshitilithi? Natu tale.

Kalunga okwa kwatha Stefanus okulonga iikumithalonga. Aalumentu mbaka inaye shi hala, ano otaye mu pataneke molwashoka ye ota longo oshigwana oshili. Ihe Kalunga ota pe Stefanus omayele ogendji, Stefanus nota holola kutya aalumentu mbaka ohaa longo aantu iinima yiifundja. Otashi ya geyitha nokuli noonkondo. Ano yo otaye mu kwata notaya kongo aantu ya hokolole iifundja kombinga ye.

Omusaaseri omukuluntu ota pula Stefanus: ‘Iinima mbika oyoshili?’ Stefanus ota yamukula mokuninga oshipopiwa sha tsa sha za mOmbimbeli. Lwokehulilo ye ota hokolola nkene aalumentu aawinayi methimbo lya piti ya li ye tonde aaprofeti yaJehova. Opo nduno ota ti: ‘Ne omwa fa naanaa aalumentu mbeyaka. Ne omwa dhipaga omupiya gwaKalunga Jesus noihamu dhiginine oompango dhaKalunga.’

Shika otashi geyitha aawiliki yomalongelokalunga mbaka noonkondo! Yo otayi ikokota komayego molwondjahi. Opo nduno Stefanus ota ligamene kegulu nota ti: ‘Tala! Ngame ondi wete Jesus a thikama kolulyo lwaKalunga megulu.’ Opo mpoka aalumentu mbaka otaa thitike omakutsi gawo niikaha yawo notaa nukile Stefanus. Yo otaye mu kwata notaye mu kokolola mo moshilando.

Hoka yo otaa hula mo oonguwo dhawo notaye dhi thigi metonatelo lyomulumentu omugundjuka Saulus. Saulus ou mu wete? Opo nduno yamwe yomaalumentu otaa tameke okudhaadhiga Stefanus nomamanya. Stefanus ota tsu oongolo, ngaashi to vulu oku shi mona mpaka, nota galikana kuKalunga: ‘Jehova, ino ya geyelela oshilonga shika oshiwinayi.’ Ye okwa tseya kutya yamwe yomuyo oya pukithwa kaawiliki yomalongelokalunga. Konima yaashika Stefanus ota si.

Uuna gumwe te ku ningile uuwinayi, ngoye oto kambadhala mbela oku mu ehameka wo nenge okupula Kalunga oye e mu ehameke? Shika hasho Stefanus nenge Jesus ya ningi. Yo oya li aanambili nokuli naamboka ya li kaaye na ombili nayo. Natu kambadhale tu landule oshiholelwa shawo. Iilonga 6:8-15; 7:1-60.

OWA tseya mbela kutya olye a lala mpoka pevi? Oye Saulus. Oto dhimbulukwa ndishi, ye okwa tonatelele oonguwo dhaalumentu mboka ya dhipaga Stefanus nomamanya. Tala kuuyelele mboka tau adhima! Oshike tashi ningwa po?

Konima yeso lyaStefanus, Saulus ota kutha ewiliko mokukonga aalanduli yaJesus ye ya ninge nayi. Ye ota yi megumbo limwe nokuya mekwawo note ya kokolola mo note ya tula mondholongo. Aalongwa oyendji otaa yi ontuku kiilando yilwe notaa tameke okuuvitha hoka “onkundana ombwanawa.” Ihe Saulus ota yi kiilando yilwe oku ka konga aalanduli yaJesus. Ye ngashingeyi oku li mondjila okuya kuDamasko. Ihe mondjila oshinima oshikumithi otashi ningwa po:

Ombadhilila uuyelele wokegulu owa adhima momudhingoloko gwaSaulus. Ye oti ihata pevi, ngaashi tse tu wete mpaka. Opo nduno ewi otali ti: ‘Saul, Saul! Omolwashike to tidhagula ndje?’ Aalumentu puSaulus oye wete uuyelele noye uvite ewi ihe yo kaye uvite ko shoka tashi tiwa.

‘Omuwa, ongoye olye?’ Saulus ta pula.

‘Ongame Jesus, oongoka ngoye to tidhagula,’ ewi tali ti. Jesus ote shi ti molwashoka kuye osha fa ongo Saulus te mu tidhagula uuna Saulus ta tidhagula aalanduli ye.

Ngashingeyi Saulus ota pula: ‘Ondi na okuninga shike, Omuwa?’

‘Thikama, ngu u ye kuDamasko,’ Jesus ta ti. ‘Hoka oto ka lombwelwa shoka u na okuninga.’ Sho Saulus ta thikama nota tonatitha omeho ge, ye ita vulu okumona sha. Ye omuposi! Ano aalumentu mboka ye li pamwe naye otaye mu kwata moshikaha notaye mu fala kuDamasko.

Ngashingeyi Jesus ota popi nagumwe gwomaalongwa ye muDamasko nota ti: ‘Ananias, thikama. Inda kOndjila Yu Uka. Pula megumbo lyaJudas omulumentu gwedhina Saulus. Ngame onde mu hogolola a kale omupiya gwandje i ikalekelwa.’

Ananias ota vulika kuJesus. Sho ye ta tsakaneke Saulus, ota tenteke iikaha ye kuye nota ti: ‘Omuwa okwa tumu ndje kungoye opo ngoye u vule ishewe okumona ko nou udhithwe nombepo ondjapuki.’ Mbala momeho gaSaulus otamu gu iinima ya fa iipakosolwa nota vulu ishewe okumona ko.

Saulus ota longithwa komukalo omukumithi okuuvithila aantu yomiigwana oyindji. Ye ota tseyika ko oye omuyapostoli Paulus, ngoka tse tatu ki ilonga natango oshindji kuye. Ihe natu tale tango kutya Kalunga ota tumu Petrus a ka ninge shike. Iilonga 8:1-4; 9:1-20; 22:6-16; 26:8-20.

OYE omuyapostoli Petrus ngoka a thikama mpaka, nayamwe yomookuume ke oya thikama konima ye. Ihe omolwashike omulumentu ta tsile Petrus oongolo? Mbela ye oku na oku shi ninga? Owa tseya kutya oye lye?

Omulumentu oye Kornelius. Oye Omuroma omukuluntu gwetanga lyaakwiita. Kornelius ina tseya Petrus, ihe ye okwa lombwelwa e mu hiye kegumbo lye. Natu tale nkene shika sha ningwa.

Aalanduli yaJesus yotango oya li Aajuda, ihe Kornelius ke shi Omujuda. Ihe ye oku hole Kalunga, oha galikana kuye noha ningile aantu iinima oyindji iiwanawa. Omutenya gumwe omuyengeli ote mu holokele nota ti: ‘Kalunga oku ku hole, note ku uva omagalikano goye. Tuma aalumentu yamwe komulumentu gwontumba gwedhina Petrus. Ye okwa kala muJoppe megumbo lyaSimon, ngoka a kala mooha dhefuta.’

Ano Kornelius ota tumu mbala aalumentu ya ka konge Petrus. Esiku lya landula, sho aalumentu taye ya popepi naJoppe, Petrus oku li kombanda yongulu yegumbo lyaSimon. Hoka Kalunga ota dhiladhilitha Petrus opo a mone onguwo onene tayi kuluka megulu. Monguwo omu na iinamwenyo yomaludhi gi ili nogi ili. Pampango yaKalunga iinamwenyo mbika oya li inaayi yogoka nokuliwa, ihe nando ongeyi ewi otali ti: ‘Thikama, Petrus. Dhipaga ngoye u lye.’

‘Aawe!’ Petrus ta yamukula. ‘Ngame inandi lya nando nale sha inaashi yogoka.’ Ihe ewi otali ti kuPetrus: ‘Etha po okwiithana shoka Kalunga ta ti ngashingeyi osha yogoka, inaashi yogoka.’ Otashi ningwa iikando itatu. Manga Petrus a kuminwa shoka tashi ti, aalumentu mboka Kornelius a tumu otaye ya pegumbo notaa pula Petrus.

Petrus ota londoloka nota ti: ‘Ongame omulumentu ngoka tamu kongo. Omolwashike mwe ya po?’ Sho aalumentu taa yelitha kutya omuyengeli oye a lombwele Kornelius a hiye Petrus kegumbo lye, Petrus ota zimine a ye pamwe nayo. Esiku lya landula Petrus nookuume ke otaa yi ya ka talele po Kornelius muKesarea.

Kornelius okwa gongela aakwawo nookuume ke yopothingo. Sho Petrus te ya, Kornelius ota yi e ke mu tsakaneke. Ye oti ihata pevi nota tsu oongolo koompadhi dhaPetrus, ngaashi u wete mpaka. Ihe Petrus ota ti: ‘Thikama po; nangame wo omuntu owala.’ Eeno, Ombimbeli otayi shi ulike kutya osha puka okutsila omuntu oongolo noku mu galikana. Tse otu na owala okugalikana Jehova.

Ngashingeyi Petrus otu uvithile mboka ya gongala. ‘Ngame ondi wete kutya Kalunga oha taamba ko aantu ayehe mboka ya hala oku mu longela,’ Petrus ta ti. Manga ta popi, Kalunga ota tumu ombepo ye ondjapuki, naantu otaa tameke okupopya momalaka gi ili nogi ili. Otashi kumitha aalongwa Aajuda mboka ye ya naPetrus, oshoka yo oya dhiladhila kutya Kalunga oha sile owala ohenda Aajuda. Ano otashi ya longo kutya Kalunga iha tala ko aantu yomuhoko gumwe oyo aawanawa nenge ya simana ye vule aantu yomuhoko gulwe. Osho sha oshiwanawa shoka tse atuheni tatu vulu okudhimbulukwa, hasho mbela? Iilonga 10:1-48; 11:1-18; Ehololo 19:10.

OMULUMENTU omugundjuka ngoka ngoye u wete mpaka e li pamwe nomuyapostoli Paulus, oye Timoteus. Timoteus okwa kala pamwe nuukwanegumbo we muListra. Edhina lyayina oEunike nolyayinakulu oLoide.

Osho oshikando oshititatu Paulus ta talele po Listra. Konyala omvula yimwe sho ya piti po Paulus naBarnabas oyi ile oshikando shotango okutalela po mpaka pethimbo lyolweendo lwetumo. Nonga-shingeyi Paulus okwa galuka pamwe nakuume ke Silas.

Owa tseya mbela kutya Paulus ota ti shike kuTimoteus? ‘Ngoye owa hala mbela okuya pamwe nangame naSilas?’ ye ta pula. ‘Tse otatu vulu okulongitha ekwatho lyoye uuna tatu uvithile aantu yokomahala gokokule.’

‘Eeno,’ Timoteus ta yamukula, ‘ngame onda halelela okuya pamwe nane.’ Ano mbala konima yethimbo Timoteus ota thigi po uukwanegumbo we nota yi pamwe naPaulus naSilas. Ihe manga tse inaatu hokolola olweendo lwawo, natu tale tango shoka sha ningilwa Paulus pokati mpono. Odho oomvula 17 okuza sho Jesus e mu ihololele mondjila yokuDamasko.

Dhimbulukwa kutya Paulus okwa yile kuDamasko okutidhagula aalongwa yaJesus, ihe ngashingeyi oye mwene omulongwa! Konima yamwe yomaatondi ye otaa dhiladhila okudhipaga Paulus, oshoka yo kaye hole elongo lye kombinga yaJesus. Ihe aalongwa otaa kwatha Paulus a ye ontuku. Yo otaye mu tula moshimbamba notaye mu kulukithile kombanda yenkolokuma lyoshilando.

Konima Paulus ota yi a ka uvithe muAntiokia. Moka aalanduli yaJesus oyi ithanwa lwotango Aakriste. Opo nduno Paulus naBarnabas okuza muAntiokia otaa tumwa molweendo lwetumo okuya kiilongo yokokule. Shimwe shomiilando mbyoka yo taa talele po osho Listra, moka mwa kala Timoteus.

Sho omvula yimwe konyala ya piti po, Paulus ota galukile muListra pethimbo lyolweendo olutiyali. Owa tseya kutya openi yo taa yi uuna Timoteus ta yi pamwe naPaulus naSilas? Tala kokaalita e to ilongo okutseya gamwe gomomahala. Yo otaa yi tango popepi puIkonio, opo nduno okoshilando oshitiyali shedhina Antiokia. Konima otaa yi kuTroas, nopo nduno okuFilippi, Tessalonika naBerea. Ou wete Atena mokaalita? Paulus otu uvitha hoka. Konima yaashono yo otayu uvitha omvula netata muKorinto. Lwahugunina yo otaa talele po paufupi muEfeso. Opo nduno otaa sayila okuya kuKesarea, notaa yi kuAntiokia, hoka Paulus a kala.

Ano Timoteus ohe ende ookilometa omathele nomathele okukwathela Paulus okuuvitha “onkundana ombwanawa” nokutota omagongalo ogendji gAakriste. Ngele ngoye wa koko, oto ka kala ngaa mbela omupiya gwaKalunga omudhiginini ngaashi Timoteus? Iilonga 9:19-30; 11:19-26; ontopolwa 13 sigo 17; 18:1-22.

AKWETU! Oshike tashi ningwa mpaka? Omumati ngoka a lala pevi okwe ehama mbela unene? Tala! Gumwe gwomaalumentu mboka taa zi megumbo, oye Paulus. Timoteus naye ou mu wete wo mpoka? Omumati okwa gu mbela pekende?

Eeno, osho naanaa shoka sha ningwa po. Paulus okwa ningile aalongwa oshipopiwa mpaka muTroas. Ye okwa tseya kutya ite ke ya mona we mbala, oshoka esiku lya landula ye okwa li e na okuya nosikepa. Ano ye okwa popi sigo omokati kuusiku.

Omumati nguka gwedhina Eutikus okwa li a kuutumba pekende nokwa kwatwa koomposi. Ye okwa gu okuza pekende po pwene lyontala ontitatu e ta gwile pevi! Ano oto vulu okuuva ko molwashike aantu taa monika ya kumwa ngawo. Sho aalumentu taa toola po omumati, osho naanaa ngaashi yo ya dhiladhila. Ye okwa sa!

Sho Paulus ta mono kutya omumati okwa sa, ye ota lala kombanda ye note mu papatele. Opo nduno ye ota ti: ‘Inamu kala mwa tila. Ye oku li nawa!’ Nosho naanaa shi li ngaaka! Osho oshikumithalonga! Paulus okwe mu yumudha! Ongundu yaantu otayi ligola kenyanyu.

Yo ayehe otaa shuna ishewe pombanda notaa li. Paulus ota popi sigo taku ningi koongulasha. Ihe oto vulu okukala nuushili kutya Eutikus ina kwatwa we koomposi! Opo nduno Paulus naTimoteus naaendi ooyakwawo otaa yi mosikepa. Owa tseya mbela kutya openi yo taa yi? Paulus okwi ipyakidhila nokumana olweendo lwe lwetumo olutitatu noku li mondjila okuya kegumbo. Pethimbo lyolweendo nduno Paulus okwa kala oomvula ndatu moshilando Efeso. Ano olwo nokuli olweendo olule lu vule olweendo lwe olutiyali.

Sho osikepa tayi thigi po Troas, yo otayi kankama okathimbo muMileto. Molwashoka okuza mpoka okuya kuEfeso opu na owala ookilometa dhontumba, Paulus ota tumu elaka kaakuluntu yegongalo ye ye kuMileto opo ye a vule okupopya nayo oshikando shahugunina. Alikana osha li she ya yematitha ngiini okutopoka naPaulus sho ethimbo lyokuya kwosikepa lya thikana!

Lwahugunina osikepa otayi ya pu-Kesarea. Manga Paulus e li megumbo lyomulongwa Filippus, omuprofeti Agabus ota londodha Paulus. Ye ota ti kutya Paulus ota ka ninga onkwatwa ngele e ya kuJerusalem. Nosho naanaa sha ningwa. Sho ye a li oomvula mbali mondholongo muKesarea, Paulus okwa tuminwa kuRoma a ka hokololithwe komupangeli gwaRoma Omukeesali. Natu tale shoka sha ningwa po pethimbo lyolweendo lwokuRoma. Iilonga ontopolwa 19 sigo 26.

TALA! Osikepa oyi li muudhigu! Otayi tekauka! Ou wete aantu mboka taa nukile momeya? Yamwe oye li nale komunkulo. OPaulus mbela ngwiiyaka? Natu tale kutya oshike she mu ningilwa.

Dhimbulukwa kutya Paulus okwa li uule woomvula mbali onkwatwa muKesarea. Opo nduno ye noonkwatwa dhilwe otaa londekwa mosikepa notaa yi kuRoma. Sho yo taa sayila taa piti popepi nontuntu yaKreta, oshikungulu oshidhigu unene otashi ya adha. Ombepo otayi pepe noonkondo naalumentu itaa vulu okuhinga osikepa. Noitaa vulu okumona etango omutenya, nuusiku yo itaa vulu okumona oonyothi. Lwahugunina, konima yomasiku ogendji, aantu mboka ye li mosikepa oya kanitha etegameno alihe lyokuhupithwa.

Opo nduno Paulus ota thikama nota ti: ‘Nando gumwe gwomune ta ka sa; osikepa oyo owala tayi ka kana. Oshoka uusiku wa piti omuyengeli gwaKalunga okwi ile kungame nokwa ti: “Paulus, ino kala wa tila! Ngoye ou na okuthikama koshipala shomupangeli gwaRoma Omukeesali. Kalunga nota ka hupitha ayehe ye li mosikepa.” ’

Konyala mokati kuusiku esiku eti-14 lyoshikungulu aanasikepa otaa mono kutya omeya gefuta otaga shuna pevi! Mokutila kutya sikulimwe yo molwomilema otaye ki ipuma momamanya, yo otaa kulukitha mo omakwatitho. Ongula ya landula yo oye wete oshikololo. Yo otaa tokola okuya nosikepa yu ukilila sigo okomunkulo.

Sho yo ye ya popepi nomunkulo, osikepa otayi tsu moshituntu shehekevi notayi dhama. Opo nduno oma-kuthikuthi otagi idhenge muyo nosikepa otayi tameke okutekauka. Omukuluntu gwetanga lyaakwiita ota popi ta ti: ‘Amuhe mboka tamu vulu okuyoga, one mu nukila tango mefuta ne mu yoge mu uka komunkulo. Oshihupe omu na okunukila mo konima yawo nomu ikwatelele kiipambu yosikepa mwa dhiginina.’ Nosho shoka yo taa ningi. Komukalo ngoka aantu ayehe 276 mboka ya li mosikepa otaa thiki komunkulo ya gamenwa, ngaashi naanaa omuyengeli u uvaneka.

Ontuntu ohayi ithanwa Malta. Aantu oyo aanambili noonkondo, notaa sile oshimpwiyu mboka ya li mosikepa. Sho ombepo ya kala nawa, Paulus ota tulwa mosikepa yilwe nota falwa kuRoma. Iilonga 27:1-44; 28:1-14, faathanitha OB-l986.

OU WETE Paulus ngoka e li momalyenge? Opu na wo omukwiita Omuroma ngoka te mu tonatele. Paulus oye onkwatwa muRoma. Ye okwa tegelela Omukeesali gwaRoma a tokole shoka ye ta ningilwa. Manga ye onkwatwa, aantu otaa pitikwa ye mu talele po.

Konima yomasiku gatatu sho Paulus e ya muRoma, ye ota hiya aawiliki yontumba Aajuda ye mu talele po. Ano oyendji yomAajuda yomuRoma otaye ya. Paulus ote ya uvithile kombinga yaJesus nUukwaniilwa waKalunga. Yamwe oyi itaale noya ningi Aakriste, ihe yalwe inayi itaala.

Paulus otu uvithile wo aakwiita yi ili noyi ili mboka ye na oku mu tonatela. Uule woomvula mbali ndhoka ye e li mpaka oye onkwatwa, Paulus ota tsikile nokuuvithila ayehe mboka ye ta tsakaneke. Ano nokuli uukwanegumbo wOmukeesali otau uvu kombinga yonkundana ombwanawa yUukwaniilwa, yamwe yomuyo notaa ningi Aakriste. Ihe olye omutalelipo ngoka a kuutumba poshitaafula nota nyola? Oto vulu okutengeneka mbela? Eeno, oye Timoteus. Timoteus naye wo okwa li mondholongo molwashoka ye u uvitha kombinga yUukwaniilwa, ihe ye okwa mangululwa mo ishewe. Nokwe ya a kwathe Paulus. Owa tseya mbela kutya Timoteus ota nyola shike? Natu tale.

Oto dhimbulukwa mbela oshilando shaFilippi noshaEfeso mEhokololo 110? Paulus okwa kwathele okutota omagongalo gAakriste miilando mbyoka. Manga Paulus e li mondholongo, ye ota nyolele Aakriste mboka oombilive. Oombilive omo dhi li mOmbimbeli, nohadhi ithanwa Aaefeso nAafilippi. Paulus ota hokololele Timoteus mpaka shoka e na okunyolela ookuume ke Aakriste yomuFilippi.

Aafilippi oya li ye li nawa kuPaulus. Yo oye mu tumine omagano mpaka mondholongo, ano Paulus ote ya pandula molwago. Epafroditus oye ngoka e eta omagano. Ihe ye okwa li te ehama noonkondo nokonyala a se. Ngashingeyi ye oku li ishewe nawa nokwi ilongekidha okushuna kegumbo. Ye ota ka faalela ombilive ndjika ya zi kuPaulus naTimoteus uuna ye ta shuna kuFilippi.

Manga ye e li mondholongo, Paulus ota nyola natango oombilive mbali ndhoka dhi li mOmbimbeli. Yimwe oyAakriste yomoshilando shaKolossa. Owa tseya mbela kutya ohayi ithanwa ngiini? Aakolossa. Onkwawo oyo ombilive yopaumwene yakuume ke kopothingo gwedhina Filemon ngoka a kala wo muKolossa. Ombilive ndjika oyi na ko nasha nomupiya gwaFilemon Onesimus.

Onesimus okwa yi Filemon ontuku nokwa yi kuRoma. Ano Onesimus oku uvu kutya Paulus oku li mondholongo muka. Ye okwe ya e mu talele po, Paulus noku uvithile Onesimus. Mbala Onesimus okwa ningi wo Omukriste. Ngashingeyi Onesimus oku uvite nayi sho ye a yi ontuku. Owa tseya mbela kutya Paulus ota nyola shike mombilive ndjika yaFilemon?

Paulus ota pula Filemon a dhimine po Onesimus. ‘Otandi mu tumine kungoye,’ Paulus ta nyola. ‘Ihe ngashingeyi ye ke shi owala omupiya gwoye. Ye omumwanyoko wo Omukriste omwaanawa.’ Sho Onesimus ta shuna kuKolossa, ye ota faalele oombilive ndhika mbali, yimwe oyAakolossa nonkwawo oyaFilemon. Tse otatu vulu okudhiladhila owala nkene Filemon a nyanyukwa sho ye tu uvu kutya omupiya gwe okwa ninga Omukriste.

Sho Paulus ta nyolele kAafilippi nokuFilemon, ye oku na onkundana ombwanawa noonkondo. ‘Otandi tumu Timoteus kune,’ Paulus ta ti kAafilippi. ‘Ihe otandi mu talele po wo mbala.’ NokuFilemon ye ota nyola: ‘Longekidhila ndje ehala lyokukala hoka pune.’

Sho Paulus ta mangululwa mo, ye ota talele po aamwayina Aakriste aalumentu naakiintu momahala ogendji. Ihe konima Paulus okwa ningi ishewe onkwatwa muRoma. Oshikando shika ye oku shi shi kutya ye ota ka dhipagwa. Ano ye ota nyolele Timoteus note mu pula e ye mbala. ‘Ngame onda li omudhiginini muKalunga,’ Paulus ta nyola, ‘Kalunga nota ka pa ndje ondjambi.’ Oomvula oonshona konima yeso lyaPaulus, Jerusalem otashi hanagulwa po, oshikando shika okAaroma.

Ihe Ombimbeli oyi na natango oshindji. Jehova Kalunga ota nyolitha omuyapostoli Johannes omambo gOmbimbeli gahugunina, mwa kwatelwa Ehololo. Embo ndika otali hokolola kombinga yonakuyiwa. Natu tale ngashingeyi kutya onakuyiwa oya kwatela mo shike. Iilonga 28:16-31; Aafilippi 1:13; 2:19-30; 4:18-23; Aaheberi 13:23; Filemon 1-25; Aakolossa 4:7-9; 2 Timoteus 4:7-9.
